messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: minimal-ruby-sampleapp hitting a weird auth/retry interaction in the onboarding flow. Steps: start the sample app, run `bundle exec ruby sample.rb`, after the first token refresh we see a 401 and then the retry loop keeps hammering the token endpoint -> app effectively hangs. Repro locally on macOS and in CI. Anyone seen this?

kevin: Yep, ran into that earlier today. Looks like the oauth refresh is happening async but our retry middleware assumes sync semantics, so retries start immediately. I have a small fix in mind. :thinking_face:

oliver: Saw the same in CI logs. Relevant trace: `Net::HTTPUnauthorized` from token client, then the retry middleware computes backoff that ends up 0 and does `sleep(0)` repeatedly. Minimal snippets: 
```ruby
# token client
resp = http.post('/oauth/token', payload)
raise Net::HTTPUnauthorized unless resp.code == '200'
```
and the middleware: 
```ruby
backoff = base * (2**attempt) - jitter
backoff = [backoff, 0].max
sleep(backoff)
```
So negative jitter can drive it to zero.

ci-bot: Build #4821 failed: sampleapp-integration (auth-e2e). Logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood.example/4821/artifacts/log.txt

sara: @kevin can we clamp the backoff min to something like 0.1s and add a max attempts guard? Also we should call out `REDWOOD_OAUTH_ROTATION` in the quickstart README so new users understand the local race window during token rotation.

kevin: I'll open a tiny PR to change middleware to `sleep([backoff, 0.1].max)` and add `max_retries: 5`. Will add an e2e repro test where token endpoint returns 401 then 200 to make sure we don't spin. I'll tag for review when ready.

maria: Thanks — please also add a short note in the sample app `README.md` about `REDWOOD_OAUTH_ROTATION=true` and local token caching behavior. That saved me 30 minutes.

oliver: :thumbsup: If tests look good I'll queue a backport to the 1.2.x gem branch for customers who pinned earlier versions.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/2932 — `devex: clamp oauth retry backoff + max attempts for sampleapp`. CI is running, tagging @sara for release decision.

sara: Nice. If CI is green can we cut a patch release? This is noisy for onboarding and will reduce support tickets.
